Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Mindllama's mindful-reminders screen - springy swipeable quote cards with mascot art, a "Remind me to breathe" button that triggers the notification permission prompt, then a paywall sliding up as a bottom sheet.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark navy "Mindful Reminders" screen. Center: a large sky-blue rounded card with a quote ("Think of many things. Do one.") above a mascot illustration (sloth with heart glasses; next card: yellow dog with "Change the world by being yourself."). Bottom: white "Remind me to breathe" pill. Later: the system notification alert appears over the dimmed card, then a paywall sheet ("Stress less with cute characters", character previews, plan rows, trial badge) rises from the bottom.

## Motion spec
Pattern: springy card swipe into a sheet stack.
- Swipe the quote card horizontally: it follows the finger 1:1 with slight rotation (+-4deg), and on release past ~35% it flies off (400ms, ease-out) while the next card springs in from the opposite side (stiffness ~260, damping ~22).
- The quote text and mascot arrive as one card - no separate text transition.
- Tap "Remind me to breathe": the system notification permission alert presents with the standard scale-and-fade over a dimmed screen.
- On alert dismissal, the paywall sheet slides up (spring stiffness ~280, damping ~26) to near-full height, the reminders screen dimming and scaling back ~4% behind it.

## Calibration
- The card swipe needs the rotation; a flat slide loses the physical playing-card feel.
- Paywall appears only after the permission prompt resolves - never stack both at once.

## Reduced motion
Cards crossfade; paywall fades in without slide.

## Don't miss
- Each quote card pairs its own mascot and quote - they never mix across cards.
- The reminders screen stays visible (dimmed, scaled back) behind the paywall rather than being covered by an opaque page.
